    # Identify horizontal bars and compress spatial arrangement into 2x3.
    bars=[]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        c=0
        while c<len(row):
            if row[c] in (2,3):
                v=row[c]; j=c
                while j<len(row) and row[j]==v:j+=1

    th=[b for b in bars if b[0]==3]

    # below-center bars in bottom row, side chosen by horizontal location.
    for _,r,c,n in tw:

        row=0 if r < midr else 1
        out[row][col]=2
    return out
